full_judgment:
18. Mr. Khandaker Reza-e-Raquib appearing for the respondent no. 2 submits that the respondent no. 2 has filed affidavit-in-compliance dated 7-2-2023 in compliance to the order dated 13-4-2022. By referring to the affidavit-in-compliance, the learned advocate submits that the petitioner companies are ISP license holders under the respondent no. 2 and the particular of shareholders of the petitioner companies are similar with those of the records kept with the respondent no.l. He further submits that APX Network (Pvt.) Ltd. is not a license holder under the respondent No. 2 and so, it does not possess any documents in respect of shareholders of that company. He finally submits that the respondent No. 2 has already approved the merger of licenses of the petitioner companies on 16-11-2022. 

 (3) It is also ordered that the whole undertaking and properties both movable and immovable including the landed properties under lease and liabilities of the transferor-companies shall be vested in and transferred to the transferee-Company including the mutation and records of rights, subject to the compliance of the terms and conditions of the said scheme of amalgamation and restructuring. 

 Let the records of the petitioner companies be sent down to RJSC.
